name: terminal-guru
description: Terminal diagnostics, tool composition, workflow discovery, environment expert, and multi-Claude team orchestration (via tmux panes) for macOS/Unix systems. Includes an orchestrator agent that diagnoses problems across the terminal stack (substrate → shell → multiplexer → sessions → apps → automation), composes tools into workflows, discovers usage patterns, and slash commands (/team-spawn, /team-list) that enforce the persistent-teammate spawn pattern. Seven focused skills: terminal-emulation (Unix substrate: $TERM, terminfo, ANSI/256/truecolor, Unicode), zsh-dev (autoload functions, fpath, testing, performance), tmux-dev (pane/window/session addressing, send/receive, options, format strings, plugins, hooks), tui-experience (fzf/television/lazygit/k9s/btop theming + asciinema/vhs recording), signals-monitoring (macOS logging, Unix signals, file watching, notifications), environment-composition (tool composition engine, fzf patterns, workflow discovery, sesh config, unix composition primer), and mise-tooling (mise.toml config, task automation, multi-tenant credentials, tool versioning).
